decisionsTitle: Under the new look: «Urmărește-ne» is a label, «Vino cu noi» leaves the header, and both languages are back on the footer's bar (amending §722, §708)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-11, seeing §722 on the site:** the pair at the header's end should have been only «Urmărește-ne» — «just a pretty indicator», not a call to action, not clickable; everywhere, the phone too, no «Vino cu noi» button in the header; and «language switcher trebuie să fie în footer să văd ambele limbi, ca înainte» — the language in the footer, showing both languages, as before. Under «Aspectul nou» only (decision 12 of `docs/REDESIGN.md`); off, every page is what it is today, the backoffice never changes, and the logo stays blue (§711).

**Decision — no call to action in the header.** `HeaderCta` is gone, and with it the header's read of the next weekly run (`joinTarget`): under the look the header hands the nav no trailing children at any width, so on a phone the ☰ is the row's right edge again (§699) and on a computer the row is the logo, the nav and its ☰, then «Urmărește-ne». The look costs the header no query: the socials are environment values. `SiteNav`'s trailing slot (§708) stays, empty, for whatever comes next; `ArrowButtonLink` loses its `compactOnPhone`, which only the header's pill used. «Vino cu noi» stays where it is a call to action: the home page's hero (§717). The design page's side-by-side no longer draws the header's pill or the floating button. `Site.cta.join` and the design page's two row labels leave both catalogues.

**Decision — «Urmărește-ne» is a label.** It already was not a link (§722: a `span`, hidden from a screen reader, which hears the words once as the navigation's name); it now also says so to a pointer: `cursor: default`, no text selection, and the unit and e2e gates check it is inside no link, button or `tabindex` element, is not focusable, and that the group's only links are the three marks, Instagram, Facebook and Strava, each still a 44-pixel target named «{club} pe …». From `md` up, as before (the owner's ask was the desktop's): below `md` the footer's bar carries the marks and the phone's header keeps its one row.

**Decision — both languages on the footer's bar.** §722's `FloatingLocaleSwitch` — one round button offering only the other language — is gone. Under the look's scope the footer's own box (the rule, then `LocaleSwitcher`: RO and EN, the current one stated with `aria-current`, the other a link through `/api/locale`) is drawn at every width — `display: { xs: "flex", sm: "none" }` and `[UNDER_LOOK]: { display: "flex", ml: "auto" }` — so it is the bar's last item at its bottom right: below 600 px exactly as before §722 (§262, §372, §385: flags only, the bar's 24- and 28-pixel targets); from 600 px the flag and the code at 44 pixels, carried to the bar's right end by an auto margin (from `sm` the fold is only as wide as its words; on a phone the fold already takes the free room, so the margin is zero), with the bar's 4-pixel gap either side of the rule. The header's copy stays hidden under the scope (`notUnderLook`), its far end being «Urmărește-ne»'s: one «Limbă» navigation at every width, in the footer, both languages in it. CSS alone, so the footer reads no setting: the layout renders `<SiteFooter />` again, without §722's `newLook` prop. Off, and in the backoffice (outside the scope), the bar and the header are exactly what they were. This amends §722's language decisions and BR-REQ-041-01 criterion 216, restores criteria 40, 42, 48 and 59 under the look, and replaces BR-REQ-040-01 criterion 15: criteria 6 and 7 hold under the look as written, for the footer's switcher.

**Refused:** keeping the floating button beside the footer's switcher (two «Limbă» navigations); the switcher back in the header under the look (the owner asked for the footer, and the header's end is «Urmărește-ne»'s); a footer copy on a computer only while the phone kept the floating button (one switcher, one place); «Urmărește-ne» as a link to a page of profiles (a label is what was asked); «Urmărește-ne» on the phone's header row (three more 44-pixel marks would fold «Alergări» into the ☰ at 320 pixels, and the footer's bar already carries the marks there); deleting `SiteNav`'s trailing slot (its measuring code is tested and costs nothing empty).

**The gate:** `tests/e2e/header-nav.spec.ts` (desktop project, serial, the setting flipped through «Setări» → «Aspect» and put back): off, no `header-cta`, socials, watermark or `floating-language`; on, at 320 pixels no `header-cta` and no «Vino cu noi» link in the header, the row one row with «Alergări» and the ☰ at its right edge; at 1280 «Urmărește-ne» after the nav on the same row, its words a label (in no link, button or `tabindex`, not focusable, `cursor: default`), its three links in order and named; at 320, at 1280 and on the seeded event page, exactly one «Limbă» navigation, in the footer, Romanian marked current, «English» a link to `/api/locale?to=en&from=…`, each item a target of the bar's size, at the bar's right end, in view after a scroll to the end. `tests/e2e/look-accent.spec.ts` checks the club's accent on the calendar's «Vezi detalii» pill instead of the header's. Unit: `appearance/footer-language-look.test.ts` (the box's rules — flex on a phone, none from `sm`, flex with an auto margin under the scope — and both languages on a Romanian and an English page, one «Limbă», no floating button); `appearance/site-look-header.test.ts` (no «Vino cu noi», the nav handed nothing, no weekly-run read; the label a hidden span before the links, the marks the only links); `appearance/site-look.test.ts` (the layout's `<SiteFooter />`, the deleted file); `design/design-page.test.ts`.
changelogLine: - **«Urmărește-ne» is a label, «Vino cu noi» leaves the header, both languages back on the footer** — under «Aspectul nou» the header carries no call to action at any width, the phone too; «Urmărește-ne» is a plain indicator beside Instagram, Facebook and Strava; and the language is the footer's own switcher again, RO and EN on its bar at every width, in place of the floating round button. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: With «Aspectul nou» on, every public page carries exactly one «Limbă» navigation at every width: the footer's own switcher, the last item of its sticky bar at the bar's right end, after a one-pixel rule, showing both languages — RO and EN, the current one marked `aria-current="true"`, the other a link through `/api/locale` named in its own words — below 600 px as flags at the bar's 24- and 28-pixel targets, from 600 px as the flag and the code at 44 pixels; the header's copy is hidden and no floating button is drawn; with the setting off, and in the backoffice, the bar and the header are what they were. Replaces criterion 216 and restores criteria 40, 42, 48 and 59 under the look (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

With «Aspectul nou» on, the header carries no «Vino cu noi» and no other call to action at any width, the phone too: the nav receives no trailing children, the ☰ stays the row's right edge below `md`, and the header reads no upcoming events; from `md` up «Urmărește-ne» / "Follow us" is a label — inside no link or button, not focusable, hidden from a screen reader, which hears the words as the navigation's name — and the group's only links are its three marks. Amends criteria 207 and 217 (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Under «Aspectul nou» the language switcher is the footer's, on its bar at every width, instead of the one in the site header: criteria 6 and 7 hold for it as written — the current language marked rather than offered, the other a link that lands on the same page in the other language, resolved on the server, the code with the flag beside it from 600 px (below, the flags alone, BR-REQ-041-01 criterion 42). Replaces criterion 15 (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Urmărește-ne» a label, «Vino cu noi» out of the header, both languages back on the footer
